# Punjabi Samvad

Punjabi Samvad is an Indian non-governmental organisation headquartered in Amritsar, Punjab. Founded in 2004, it works with women, children, young people, schools, communities and institutions through education, public-health awareness, skill development, dialogue and creative advocacy.

## Main areas of work

- Women and girls
- Education and youth development
- Mental-health awareness
- Menstrual-health education
- Substance-abuse prevention
- HIV/AIDS and community-health awareness
- Vocational and digital learning
- Punjabi art, culture, theatre and literature
